memberaccess-description: Members-only wiki access with email one-time-code login and an allowlist of addresses and domains
memberaccess-code-email-validity: It works once, and stops working in $1 {{PLURAL:$1|minute|minutes}}.
memberaccess-code-email-disclaimer: If you did not ask to log in to {{SITENAME}}, nothing has happened and you can ignore this message.
memberaccess-code-email-body:
Here is your login code for {{SITENAME}}:

    $1

It works once, and stops working in $2 {{PLURAL:$2|minute|minutes}}.

If you did not ask to log in to {{SITENAME}}, nothing has happened and you can ignore this message.
memberaccess-auth-button-help: We send a one-time code to your email address. Nothing beyond your email address is requested.
memberaccess-auth-resend-help: The code already sent stops working.
memberaccess-auth-resend-throttled: Too many codes have been asked for. Use the one already sent.
memberaccess-auth-email-help: The address you are a member with.
memberaccess-auth-email-missing: Enter your email address to get a login code.
memberaccess-auth-throttled: Too many login codes have been requested. Try again later.
memberaccess-auth-code-sent: If $1 belongs to a member here, a login code is on its way. Enter it below within $2 {{PLURAL:$2|minute|minutes}}.
memberaccess-auth-code-wrong: That code is not right. $2 {{PLURAL:$2|attempt|attempts}} left for the code sent to $1.
memberaccess-auth-code-missing: Enter the login code that was emailed to you.
memberaccess-auth-code-outstanding: Enter the login code sent to $1.
memberaccess-auth-code-expired: That code can no longer be used. Ask for a new one.
memberaccess-auth-not-authorized: This address cannot be used to log in here.
memberaccess-auth-failed: Logging in did not complete. Request a new login code; if this keeps happening, contact an administrator of this wiki.
memberaccess-auth-password-refused: Members log in with a one-time code, so this account cannot have a password.
memberaccess-api-module-denied: The "$1" API module is not available to members.
right-memberaccess-manage: Manage the member allowlist and roster
action-memberaccess-manage: manage the member allowlist and roster
